messages:
Ravi Kumar: FYI merchant onboarding blocked: Azure portal rejects attestation payload for offer ID OFR-10234. Error shows missing data_privacy_contact_email.

Nina Park: Is this the new attestation field we added?

Diego Alvarez: Yep. Legal added contact email + signature_type last quarter. Many merchants still use the old PDF.

Ravi Kumar: Merchant is pushing a joint announcement next week, wants listing live ASAP. Can we accept a manual workaround?

Legal Bot: Manual acceptance allowed if signed PDF is stored in compliance locker and metadata (offer id, signer, title, email, signature type, date) provided. Revenue recognition requires signed doc.

Nina Park: Ok. I'll send merchant a one-paragraph template to paste and sign, and request they email compliance@redwood.ai and cc partnerships@redwood.ai.

Diego Alvarez: Ops note: portal UI hides backend JSON errors. Need eng ticket so missing fields show up in the upload modal. Merchant couldn't find which field failed.

Ravi Kumar: Please include that in the email so they know to send contact email field.

Nina Park: Draft sent to merchant with template and checklist.

Merchant (reply): We'll email signed PDF within 90 minutes. Can you confirm you'll attach it to the portal record?

Ravi Kumar: Yes — BizOps will ingest and mark the offer as pending-legal-review.

Marketplace Bot: Portal notice: manual attestation upload queued for OFR-10234, status: awaiting-compliance.

Diego Alvarez: I'll open an eng ticket: make validation errors visible in portal upload flow (P2).

Legal Bot: Once compliance confirms, legal will clear the offer for publish. If any fields missing we'll request re-sign.

Ravi Kumar: Thanks team. If merchant email arrives I'll update here.

Merchant (later): Sent to compliance@ and cc'd partnerships. Attachment: signed attestation PDF.

Marketplace Bot: Manual upload processed for OFR-10234, status: pending-legal-review.

Nina Park: Got it. Waiting on legal sign-off.

Ravi Kumar: Great work — fingers crossed for the co-marketing launch. :crossed_fingers:
